ns2:course.label: Intro Dairy Cattle Evaluation
ns2:course.description: Evaluation of physical traits of dairy cattle in relation to economic value and genetic improvement; sire selection, mating systems, and genetic merit for dairy cattle. Field trip required. Prerequisite: ANSC 100 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ANSC 100 or consent of instructor.
